title: I'm building a 1v1 FPS duel game, and the strongest FAIR bot ever
author: M1ghtyMe
selftext:
For the past few months I started a new project to try and build a 1v1 first person shooter, arena/quake/tf2 style game.

The main purpose is to fight vs a bot who gets progressively stronger and stronger, currently i already taught the bot how to rocket jump, air strafe and some basic gameplay skills.

Latest gameplay here: [Testing the walljump capabilities - YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6jlG4YCJd0Y)

If you want to give it a try, you can already on [www.scoville.gg](http://www.scoville.gg)

  
Still early stages, very open to feedback or any questions happy to answer!
